svg.title: A visual history of fitness and health APIs
svg.desc: A timeline of 38 dated launches, tracked changes, milestones and shutdowns, one row per year, each mark at its source's date precision and linking its source.
svg.text: A visual history of fitness and health APIs
38 dated launches, changes and shutdowns from 17 vendors, from the API graveyard and the changes tracker. Data as of November 14, 2026.
A point is a day; a bar is a month or a whole year, as the source dates it.
